$comment: Hashed denylist of identifiers that must never appear in this public repository. Values are sha256 of the lowercased, separator-stripped form, so a name matches whether it is written spaced, hyphenated or concatenated. Hashes rather than plaintext, because a plaintext list of names we must not publish would itself publish them. Add an entry with: node scripts/hash-identifier.mjs "Some Name"
normalization: lowercase, then remove every character outside [a-z0-9]
